Scope and uncertainty

Partial public profile: processor and fabric follow the TOP500 submission. Node count, socket count, memory and on-node wiring are not assumed from the server model or benchmark core count. This entry describes the ranked system or partition, not every resource operated at this site. Per-node CPU/GPU counts, RAM and local links use NVIDIA DGX H100 platform specifications; operator-specific modifications are not verified. Node specifications follow the documented NVIDIA DGX H100 platform (8U rackmount, 6 × 3.3 kW power supplies (4+2 redundant)); operator-specific deviations are not verified.
